Drag to pan
Cmd/Ctrl-drag to rotate
Scroll to zoom
Shift-click a floor/building to zoom in
⌥ over a building: its coupling, as roads (⌥-click to pin)
  yellow road, black arrows: a dependency this diff added; under ⌥ the rest fade
   ⌘/Ctrl-click a road: the source line that couples the two
 ⇧ over a building: what changes with it (co-change colour), or its whole axis (cohesion colour)
Shift-click the ground (or Esc / breadcrumb) to step out
Cmd/Ctrl-double-click opens a file in VS Code
